name: Let It Die - Complete Save Editor & Encyclopedia
changelog: Responsive Layout & Space Optimization: Reorganized Top Bar into 2 clean rows, compact 2x3 Currency HUD, ScrollableFrame on Currencies, Tower, Tools, and Save Slots.
Slot Backups & Sessions: Added 2-row action layout inside each slot card, preventing button clipping and keeping Rename and Delete buttons always accessible.
Foreign Save Compatibility & Re-binding Tool: Download saves from friends, Reddit, or Nexus Mods and adapt them to your Steam ID and account with 1-click.
Automatic Session Backups: Double-click to restore session, live metadata preview, and isolated per-slot history.
